payload.core_composition_summary: Two-stage DP: first computes all contiguous segments that can be reduced to a single value via interval DP, then uses a 1D DP to find optimal partition into such segments.
payload.rationale: The solution uses an interval DP to precompute reachable single-element reductions and then a 1D DP to minimize overall length, combining two distinct DP strategies.
